target.statement: F1 score for recognition of known/unknown on the SelfAware benchmark (3369 questions, 31% unknown) for a given LLM

compute.basis: Survey paper with no experiments; reproducing a single F1 cell requires re-implementing the evaluation protocol from scratch and running a capable LLM (e.g., Llama-2-7B) over 3369 questions on CPU, which is slow but feasible.

blockers: No code or configs released (repo is only a paper list)
No experimental results in the paper to compare against
Requires re-implementing the evaluation protocol from scratch
Running a capable LLM on CPU is slow
title: A Survey on the Honesty of Large Language Models
